title: Kiritani Haruka — Card Story

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Corridor

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Crowds are forming even along the corridor...
I hope I can get inside my classroom...

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
Kiritani!
Will you be joining another agency to restart idol activities?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but I have no intention of doing that at all.

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Haruka! I'm a huge fan of yours!
May I have your autograph, please?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I appreciate your support, but I'm no longer an idol, so...

rows.Speaker: Student C
rows.Line:
Hey, Kiritani!
Do you wanna come sing karaoke with us?

rows.Speaker: Student D
rows.Line: I wanna see Haruka singing live!

rows.Speaker: Student E
rows.Line: Kiritani! Please shake hands with me!
Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I came early today to avoid causing trouble for anyone, but I think I may need to come even earlier next time...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I had no idea there were so many people supporting me in this school too.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But I'm already...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Now that I'm no longer an idol, there's nothing I can do for them anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Pull yourself together.
I need to control my feelings and...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (M-My penguin keychain is gone...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (How... I definitely attached it to my bag!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Oh, I may have dropped it when I was being surrounded at the corridor just now...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The crowds have more or less dispersed, but if I go out, they'll probably start gathering together again...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, this isn't the time to be worried about that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I have to find it. It has to be out there somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah, good morning, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh... Good morning, Hoshino, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Morning, Haruka!
Are you looking for something? What happened?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Y-Yes... I dropped something important.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh dear! Come on, we have to find it quickly!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What did you drop?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're going to help me look?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, of course!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you...
I'm looking for a black and white penguin keychain, wearing a red scarf.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Penguin? Oh, didn't we find that just now?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes. Kiritani, are you talking about this penguin?
We found it on the floor just now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ah! Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you so much for finding it for me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ You're most welcome!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Please allow me to do something to repay you for this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Huh? There's no need.
We just happened to see it, that's all.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But if you hadn't...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I get it.
This is something really important to you, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I have a lot of other penguin merchandise too, but this is the one I've had for the longest time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You like penguins, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I just think they look so cute with their round bodies. And I can't help but keep buying the penguin merchandise I see at the aquarium.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Even idol celebrities like Haruka visit aquariums too?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is that...strange?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No way, it's not strange at all!
I'm glad to hear that, actually.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Why?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, it helps us see that you're a high school girl like us too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Actually, I've been wondering how I should talk to you...
But now I know you're just a normal classmate!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, I'd really love to get to know you better!
Would you like to have lunch together later?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How about lunch together to repay us, then?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If that's what you want, then I'm happy to oblige.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And...thank you for not seeing me as an idol...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Did you just say something?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, nothing at all. I'm looking forward to lunchtime.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The lunch stand was really crowded.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We were there during peak period, after all.
But I managed to get what I wanted!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too. What about you, Kiritani?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I bought what I wanted too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So we all got what we wanted, then!
What did you buy, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I got yakisoba bun, yakisoba bun, and yakisoba bun.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Y-You only bought yakisoba buns?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ahh, she really loves them, you see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That doesn't sound very nutritionally balanced...
Do you also eat foods like salad?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I've never minded that before...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But Saki's meals are pretty unbalanced, too, if you ask me. You eat snacks as your main meal and then that pasta you just bought is for dessert, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Th-That's not true!
I got the pasta as my main meal...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The school store had a lot of snacks for sale.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
And this one here's the latest release!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're always only buying snacks...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Says the girl who only eats yakisoba buns.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehehe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They're childhood friends, right? They get along so well.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah, by the way, what did you buy, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I bought...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Salad and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Chicken breast meat?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: These items were the most nutritionally balanced of all the food being sold in the store. Am I being odd?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No. It's amazing you even take that into consideration!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Completely different from us since we only eat what we like.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think I've seen you mention on a TV interview or something that you follow a pretty restrictive diet, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I do.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm not an idol anymore, so I can quit if I like, but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But you keep doing it anyway?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: One time, I did try to stop both my diet and training, but it made me feel so restless.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So in the end, I'm still doing my routine from before. I just don't know when to give up, huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I mean, why not?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If carrying out your routine makes you feel calmer, that means it's something essential to you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Essential...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I agree!
Just like how snacks are essential to me!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's completely different, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, you're so mean to me...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehehe. A little bit of snacking is fine.
The more you eat, though, the more you should try to exercise.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I exercise lots in my school club, so I'm safe!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Maybe I should try some salad once in a while...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, that's not fair!
Okay, I'll switch out my pasta for salad tomorrow too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shouldn't you be switching your snacks for salad instead?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe... Haha!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: See? She's laughing at you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ugh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehehe, I wasn't laughing at you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you, both of you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Don't worry, it's nothing. Come on, let's eat.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Something smells tasty.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
Smells like butter to me?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You've got a good nose.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Look, that's a cream puff store over there.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh. I didn't know there were any food stores that way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What a lucky find! Let's get something from there. Their cream puffs look so yummy. They don't skimp on the cream!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They do look tasty...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You know what, I'll just wait here while you go and get something for yourself.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Why aren't you coming, Haruka? Oh, I'm so slow.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You're on a diet?
You mentioned it in a magazine interview some time ago, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's right, I watch my calories, and those puffs really are loaded with cream...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no! Don't tell me cream puffs are calorie bombs!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They're not. Compared to other desserts, they're not terribly calorific.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course, if you eat a whole lot of them, that's a different story.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The best time for a sweet treat like this is after lunch.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When your metabolism is up and running, fill up on vegetables and some protein.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then they won't cause you a sudden spike in blood sugar.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're so careful about what and when you're eating.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But aren't you really a sucker for sweets? I saw you stop in front of that cake shop earlier, looking longingly at the display.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Um... Yeah, you got me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then why don't you have them once in a while?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I think that when you get your energy from something you love, it powers you up more, more!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She might have a point.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Training hard and sticking to a healthy diet contribute to my growth as an idol...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But doing things that make me happy is also important for staying motivated.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You always surprise me with your insight, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's go get some cream puffs.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yay! Happy cream puff time with Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, you can choose from six different types of cream filling.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Six types, wow!
Hmm, I can't choose...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which one are you getting, Haru—

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hi, I'd like two of each, please.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uh, what?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What?
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So this is where we'll be practicing today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So cool!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
This is the same studio you've been using when you were in
ASRUN, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes. We didn't have our own studio back when we were
just starting out.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I imagine it has some sentimental value to you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I suppose so.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Let's save the trip down memory lane for later. We've
got it booked only for a couple hours, so let's start
stretching.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehehe! Doing stretches together in a studio, that's such
a classic idol group thing!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Definitely. We used to do it in ASRUN too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Once we became more popular, everyone was too busy
with solo projects to meet up for group practice much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Aw, that's such a shame!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's get some good stretches in!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hm, you can stretch your legs pretty far apart. Can you
do it with your upper body flat on the floor?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Nope. I can only do it as far as almost touching the floor
with my elbows.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Isn't that good enough?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What about you girls?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I can easily put my elbows on the floor. Look.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, you really did it! And you, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I can go...this far.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, you can go flat!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
If you're not flexible, you're more prone to injury,
apparently.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Can you do a split standing up?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Like this?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Are you made of rubber?! You could star in a circus!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Or become a ballerina.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Rhythmic gymnastics is another career option for you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks, but I just want to be an idol.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Haruka, what sort of exercises do I need to do to be
flexible like you?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's enough if you stretch after taking a bath.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You don't need to do anything hardcore.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I do stretch after bath! What am I doing wrong?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How long do you stretch for, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: About an hour at a time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: An hour?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I've been doing stretches daily since I decided to become
an idol, and I've been increasing the time I spend on it
little by little.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You've been keeping this up for years. That's commitment.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Haruka, you're just so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll do my stretches daily from now on too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I probably need to do it for one to two hours a day to
have a chance of catching up with you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's not very realistic, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Minori, you mustn't do anything excessive. I understand
that you're impatient, but it's better to get into the
habit gradually.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're right!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Let's continue our stretches. Minori, want me to push
your back?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That'll be great, thanks!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That venue... I remember it fondly.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It's the place I took my first step as an idol after passing the audition...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Why did I even come here?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm no longer...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She said I inspired her to become an idol, but...)

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line: Hey, isn't that Haruka Kiritani?

rows.Speaker: Woman B
rows.Line: Huh? As in the idol? Wait, in the flesh?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ugh!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That was close...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (My life as an idol already feels like the distant past to me, and yet...)

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Hey, did you read that online article about Haruka Kiritani? A lot of those who were surveyed really want her to make a comeback.

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
I'm not surprised.
I still see special corners dedicated to her in CD shops even now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Even so, I'm...no longer...)
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Somehow I ended up here...
An's probably busy helping out at the shop, though...)

rows.Speaker: Customer
rows.Line: Thanks, I'm stuffed! See ya!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Come again soon!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Haruka?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Long time no see! Since middle school, right?
Don't just stand there, come on in!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Here, milk tea for you. I remember you liked this, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'll take a little break too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Are you sure you're allowed to slack off like that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It'll be fine. We just ran out of customers, anyway. And dad wouldn't say anything because it's you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You haven't changed at all, huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You go to Kamiyama High School, right? How is it there?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Pretty fun! A friend recruited me to be a hall monitor, and there's this weird second year who tries to bring drones and robots into school all the time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then I have this classmate who only comes to school when the mood strikes. What you'd call a free spirit, I guess?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, that does seem like something a free spirit would do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh yeah! I have something important to share.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've finally found the best singing partner to team up with!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? The partner you were looking for to help you fulfill your dream?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's right! Oh, she's also a first-year at Miya Girls. Maybe you know her!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Her name is Kohane, and we're going to be taking part in an event together soon. I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's nice...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're...not going to ask me anything?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I will...if you want me to.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The world may know you as the perfect idol, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: To me, you'll always be that girl with the bright blue penguin-shaped lunchbox who secretly eats early lunches with a huge grin on her face during class.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Th-That was when I was in my penguin craze...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
The people in class were so taken aback.
Some were even wondering if food that blue was even edible!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Some of them said it looked cute, though...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? They did?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, they did.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Wherever I go, people see me as ASRUN's Haruka Kiritani.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But to An...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I was right to come here.)
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good morning.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Welcome... Huh? Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Do you have time to talk?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sure. We just opened and there aren't any customers, yet.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What made you come all the way here on a holiday morning?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I wanted to tell you something...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I've decided to try to be an idol again.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's great!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's all, really. I just wanted you to know.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. You're so polite, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Since you're already here, you might as well let me know what made you change your mind? Support from fans?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Something like that.
I know the fans are waiting for me...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But that's not the direct reason. I have a schoolmate who said she's aspiring to become an idol because of me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's the reason.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh?
What's she like?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Honestly, I initially thought she was a bit too plain for an aspiring idol.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But she works harder than anyone I know and never gives up no matter how many times she's rejected at auditions.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: An idol isn't just a beautiful spark of light. Reality is harsh to us, and a lot of things happen backstage that fans don't know about.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She understands all of that and still thinks that idols are amazing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She insists that idols can really bring hope to people.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh wow...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She showed me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That I did bring hope to someone after all.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's why I wanted to start all over again.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haruka, your face is so clear now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But I think you may be right.
What used to look pale and gray to me has recently started to glow so brilliantly.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm really happy for you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, if you ever need a place to perform, let me know, okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can probably introduce you to most of the event venues around this area...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And I know this guy who knows a lot of people too. Whatever it is, I'm sure we can be of some help.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Don't mind if I take you up on that offer one day, then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not at all!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks for talking with me today.
I'm glad I came.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Drop by again whenever you like!
Next time, bring the girl you mentioned just now, too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, I will.
Thank you for everything!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sure, see you!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Heh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I'm so glad I got to talk to An.
Back then, it was because of her that I was able to move ahead.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This time, it's my turn to do what I can to help everyone move ahead as well.
A few days after the Sports Festival - Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Tenma, what's the matter?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's just that, I'm hungry for more...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Um, you can have some of my lunch if you want...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yay, really?! I mean...
I wasn't talking about lunch!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I think she was trying to say that she's feeling bored.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The Sports Festival was amazing, and going back to school like normal just feels so meh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ah, I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You really enjoyed yourself during the after party too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sure did! Going to a diner and celebrating with everyone! What's not to love?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I never got to do anything like that and it was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And almost everyone from our class turned up too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was surprised by how many of us there were. We had four tables all to ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe! Ordering was fun, too!
Who wants fried chicken? Raise your hands!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And making crazy concoctions at the juice bar, competing to come up with the best mix and stuff was awesome too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then Shiho's class came by later and the place was pretty much taken over by girls from our school.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! And it was sooo cute when you fed Minori some of your fried chicken, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She said she was hungry and ready to collapse, so I helped her out.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha! That made her so happy, she was on cloud nine!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, Tenma...
I should have said this earlier but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I just wanted to thank you for inviting me to the Sports Festival committee.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It was the first school event that I planned in a long time and I made some friends outside my class, like Otori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm really glad that I chose to join.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I should be the one thanking you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Organizing the event with you and Emu was an unforgettable experience, and a glorious new page in my wonderful teenage life!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So thank you for accepting my invitation too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It really was fun.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I've missed so much school because of my job...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This school was very accommodating when it came to my line of work, so even in middle school, I was allowed to skip classes.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
You went to middle school here too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, but I was practically never here. The last school event I went to before this one was a Sports Day back in elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I ran in the relay then too. I competed against the other classes as an anchor and...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: An... Oh, my best friend back then, ran against me, and no one could tell who'd win until the very end.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow! That's just like what Emu did!
Your race had to be super close too then!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, who won?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I did, but by a hair's breadth.
My friend said we'd have a rematch next year...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But we never got to do it...
I had to skip it because of work...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(An was so sulky when I told her too...
I wonder if she's still angry with me about that.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow... We are the same! I didn't really get to enjoy middle school either because I was in the hospital!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We need to make up for the time we lost and have as much fun as we can!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And you'll have plenty of school events to do just that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Maybe we can be on the committee for the next one too! I'm super hyped for whatever's coming♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, it would be nice to do it again.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's right!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We're making memories to last us a lifetime...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Thanks to Sports Festival, I no longer feel like such an outsider, and can actually look forward to more of these events...)
After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
One, two, three, four...
Okay, that should be enough stretching.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It's nice to be practicing with Minori and the others again.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I did what I could on my own when I was busy with the committee, but it's always better to train together.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hello, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Now that the Sports Festival's behind us, you can join us for practice again, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course. Thank you for letting me skipping our sessions to work on committee stuff.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, it was no problem whatsoever!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. And good job with the Sports Festival! It turned out great!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I enjoyed being able to take part with my classmates too. It was a very memorable event.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hearing that makes all my effort worth it!
But I have thank you too, Airi, Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I heard from another girl on the committee that it was you two who got the credit-based students to participate.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh that?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A lot of students here are in the same line of work as us, so you hardly ever see them and don't have many event options to choose from even if they do show up.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We ended up investing a lot of time into figuring out how many would actually show up and how they could enjoy themselves...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But thanks to you, enough of those girls agreed to come and we were able to have some of them in every competition. Even the upperclassmen were surprised by this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And it wasn't just the second years. You even went around to the first and third year students, and got them to sign up too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! That's amazing, Airi, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, it was nothing really.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. You were the selling point, Haruka. We told everyone that you were on the committee, so the event was guaranteed to be fun this year.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Regardless, it really worked.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And it was the first years who took the initiative by saying they wanted to make it better than ever...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which is why it became important to see how we can get the others to go along with us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I see...
But your worries might've been misplaced.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A second-year committee member visited our class a few times too, encouraging us to join.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And that third-year girl! Your committee members seemed so invested in it, we thought we should do something to help too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Really..?
I had no idea.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I bet they were all inspired by you first years!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow, what a story!
That's incredible!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm surprised myself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Saki said that older students helped her make the list of participants for each event...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, I'm glad it worked out...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I guess we infected everyone with our overwhelming enthusiasm!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's great, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot! You were so busy running the show that you probably didn't get to see much of anything. Want to catch up now?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is this...? A video of the entire day?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! This one's from... Oh, the ball toss!

rows.Speaker: Student A's Voice
rows.Line: <Aw, these are so cute!>

rows.Speaker: Student B's Voice
rows.Line: <Yeah, they are! Look, this ball has a different design on it! Cool!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, they really liked the pictures.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: There's this girl from my class, Shiho, who just kept mumbling, They're so cute, and kept picking them up to look at the pictures instead of throwing them!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I see.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And everyone was so motivated too.
No one gave up until the end!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. They all only had the Sports Festival on their minds.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. And we've got you to thank for it, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It was great to feel like a normal high schooler again by really having fun at a school event.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Oh, how could I forget... Airi and Shizuku have been missing out on school events now because of their work too.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I made some good memories with my classmates.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Same! It made me realize that even though being an idol is super important to me, school events are the kind of fun I don't want to miss either!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, me too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Some things you can only experience when you're a student.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right! And I want to participate in as many school events as I can from now on...!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: <You can do it, Haruka!! Go! Go! Go!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoops, I left the video on!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, that's the big relay race!
That got everyone really fired up!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There was so much cheering from every direction... Oh, it's Shii!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: <Go, Haruka! Yay, she's ahead!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Voice
rows.Line: <But she just passed a girl's from our class...>

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: <Oh no! Uh, I don't know who I should be cheering for...!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You were cheering for me even though I was competing against you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe! I couldn't help it...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Minori.
Sunday

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The next agency on my list is... Ah.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hello, this is Kiritani.
Thank you for calling me back.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, this is about the agency referral from the other day and... Yes, well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry, even though you took the trouble to make the referral. We intend to carry on as an independent idol...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, no... We won't be reconsidering.... Yes, we made this decision together after discussing it amongst ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Minori has to be together with us. It's the four of us or nothing, no compromises.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you...
I appreciate the concern. Goodbye.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(They'll take us if we leave Minori out, huh...
I understand she has no experience but...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(It was Minori who renewed my...
No, all of our desires to become idols again.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Everyone's only interested in our past achievements and not giving her a chance at all.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sigh... I have to go apologize and explain this to the other agencies too...
Some days later after school
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi was so much sharper than usual with her moves today! I hope I can dance as well as her one day.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. To achieve that, you may want to work on strengthening your core.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll be going now. Good work with practice and make sure to rest too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... H-Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ah... No, nevermind.
See you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. See you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, someone's calling... Probably another agency... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line: <Hello? Haruka? Hey, it's been a while! How've you been doing?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm good, thanks. How about you?
I heard you transferred to another agency...

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line:
<Haha, I'm good too!
I'm finally all settled into my new agency.>

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line: <But we haven't spoken since ASRUN was disbanded. Anyway, I'm gonna just cut to the chase.>

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line: <Haruka, you're trying to form a new idol group, right? Everyone here is talking about it and some are even saying they might want you to join.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line: <But! Because of budget constraints, we can only take you.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then that's...

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line: <Oh, don't worry! I was there too and it felt more like they were messing around.>

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line: <I guess they don't get that someone trying to join as a group won't take an offer that's only for one person...>

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line:
<Now, about why I really called you!
Well, it's more of a personal matter♪>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A personal matter?

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line: <Yup. Tell me more about this girl your group. Not Hinomori or Momoi. You know, the other girl!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, you mean Minori?

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line:
<Minori? So, what's she like?
How'd you meet?
I have so many questions...!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Nobody's shown any interest in Minori up to this point.)

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line: <Hello? Hey, Haruka?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. I was wondering where I should start.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I first met her when...

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line: <Wow. She's pretty amazing, huh? She managed to get not just you, but Hinomori and Momoi interested in forming an idol group together.>

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line:
<Yeah. She's gonna be an amazing idol.
I can see it already.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line: <Haha. What're you thanking me for?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Actually, nobody's shown any interest in Minori until you asked...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're the first person that I've really talked to about her.

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line:
<What, no way! Everybody's missing out!
Or they only care about short-term gains!>

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line: <I'm so glad I transferred to my current agency. The only problem is we're completely broke!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line:
<Oh, sorry. I have to get back to work.
Good luck, Haruka! I'll be rooting for you!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks... So much...
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good morning, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! Morning! Great, you're back to your usual self now!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How so?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well, you seemed so distracted yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Oh, she was trying to ask me something yesterday too, wasn't she? I see. She was worried about me.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you, Minori.
I feel much better now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really? That's great!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (People haven't had a chance to get to know Minori yet, but...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm sure people will see her potential someday. The four of us need to keep trying to make it happen.)
After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry I took so long, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? You're the only one here, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku said she'll be late because she has cleanup committee stuff to do. What about Minori?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She'll be late because of an animal caretaker committee meeting.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ah, okay. Then how about we start with some stretches then?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: One, two, three, four... Come to think of it, it's kind of rare for us to be alone together, huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, can I ask you something...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure, but... Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, there's something that's been on my mind ever since we decided to freelance.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: When we were running around trying to find an agency we could join, I was thinking that maybe...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, not maybe... You were trying to protect us from whatever we would face, weren't you?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Especially when I suggested that we go independent, you said maybe you were being too stubborn...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I don't think that's the case.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku and I quit because we didn't like how our agencies were treating us or we had problems with other group members.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It felt like you were being the most careful out of all of us and kept voicing your opinion about one thing after another.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I would be lying if I said I wasn't, but I wouldn't say I was being as careful as you believe I was.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our futures depended on it, so I just wanted to clear up any concerns or doubts we may've had before moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I didn't want us to make the same mistakes again.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It may've been for different reasons, but we all gave up being idols once already...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But after meeting Minori, we were somehow able to get back on our feet again.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because of that, I was determined not to let the hope that Minori had given us to go to waste.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yes. I feel the same way too.
And I'm sure Shizuku does as well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But because I was so focused on that, I wasn't able to think out of the box at all.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So even though I was surprised when you suggested going independent, I'm actually grateful that you brought it up.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Maybe it's just human nature...
Getting bogged down in our own thoughts.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If Rin hadn't listened to what was on my mind, I would've probably stayed stuck too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. We should definitely try to take some time to have more discussions together in the future.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We should.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But at any rate...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You really are the responsible type, huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh? I think you're no different in that regard...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're by far the most responsible person I've ever known. It's really reassuring to have you around!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll be counting on you, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sure. And I'm counting on you too, Airi.
Let's make the best of it, okay?
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(The perfect idol...
Never able to be her usual self...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We have to prepare for whichever path Shizuku ultimately decides to choose...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, that's probably enough for dance practice today. Let's start discussing what we'll be doing for our next stream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We should do whatever we can right now in order to help Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How does that sound, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry.
Um... Our next stream, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You seem really worried about Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, yeah...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Of course she is. It'd be strange if she weren't.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
May I have some time to think this over?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I... I promise to find the answer.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Friends are supposed to be there to lend a hand at times like this, but what can we do to help...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi, why don't you go and see Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I completely agree that Shizuku will have to make her own decision...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But even so, that doesn't mean she has to bear this burden all by herself.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
...!
You're right, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm gonna go look for her!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! Good luck!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're counting on you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright! That means we'll need to come up with enough ideas for streams to make up for their absence!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sure, that sounds like a plan.
Let's start by finding some videos to use as reference.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Oh, this dance group's video is incredible. Every move is synchronized perfectly, right down to their hand gestures...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(They even have a camera filming their feet.
It really adds a lot of value.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They seem to know exactly how to make their dancing look the coolest.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, what do you think about this dance group...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? What...?!
Sorry, Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
...
You're worried about Shizuku too?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Every time I try to come up with an idea, I can't help but come back to something that has to do with getting to know the real Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha. But I really shouldn't be since she hasn't even found her answer yet...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's true, but we'll need to come up with different ideas that can work with whatever she decides to do.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So I'd still like to hear what you have in mind as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?! In that case... Gasp...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-H-H-Haruka...! Y-you're so...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? I'm so...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: N-N-Never mind! I-It's n-n-n-n-nothing!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But you're all red now. You're not coming down with a fever, are you? Here, let me check your temperature...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-W-W-Wah...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sorry, I forgot one of my...
Hm? Haruka? What are you doing?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori looked like she might have a fever, so I was checking her temperature.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What?! Are you okay, Minori?!
We should get you to...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Waaahhh! N-No, I'm fine!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I just didn't expect Haruka to get so close, and was startled is all...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, that's what was going on?
But I kind of miss those reactions of yours!

rows.Speaker: Haruka

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Since Minori's going this far, I'm sure you have nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I suppose so.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks, Minori. I feel a little better now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I can't act like that on a regular basis, especially in front of our fans..

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That is true...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Aww... That's too bad...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you don't have to put on a face when you're with us, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She's right. We'd rather see you in your natural state, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks, you two.
I'll try keeping that in mind...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Great!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for watching, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Stay tuned for our next stream! Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Phew. Nice work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That went very well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Everybody really seemed to enjoy your No Blushing - Smiling Staring Contest! segment, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I didn't expect everybody to like my idea so much.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Although, a certain someone kept giggling from the start and didn't even last a second.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-Because I can't stare right at Haruka like that and keep a straight face...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm getting the giggles just thinking about it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I understand completely. There were quite a few comments that even mentioned how you have such a lovely smile.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! Another person even said, You'd be able to make a crying baby cheer up and laugh!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's so true! Haruka's smile has the power to make anybody's heart race!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's almost too hard to believe that she used to have trouble smiling at all.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I read about it in an interview that she did for an article a while back, and mentioned how she had trouble smiling when she was little.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, is that true?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. It has to do with when I was really little, around the time I was in kindergarten or just starting elementary school...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I apparently had so much trouble with it that everyone else began calling me the girl who doesn't smile...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That sounds like the complete opposite of you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But this one idol changed all of that for you, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We can't get anything by you, can we, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Who? Which idol?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She wasn't on TV much, so she wasn't all that famous but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wow... And I kept touting how I knew so much about idols, but I've never heard of this person before.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I tried looking her up after I read Haruka's interview, but all I could find was her birthday and hometown.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wanna try telling us more about what this idol was like, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'd like to learn more too.
Especially since they turned your frown upside down, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks. I'll make sure to bring by one of her CDs next time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I have the one photo album that she released too, so I'd like you all to see that too. It's something I treasure quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You have her photo album? That's great!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I can't wait to see what you bring, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I hope you like them.
Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's see... I'm pretty sure I put that CD and album... Oh, here they are!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I still listen to these songs from time to time, but it's been so long since I last looked at this album...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And it's really more like a collection of vacation photos...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Some involve interacting with the locals, like having meals with them and such, while others capture children pulling pranks on them...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Everybody seems so happy too.
Their smiles are so beautiful...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(It's the same with each photo too.
Her smile is what's causing everybody around her to feel so much joy.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I went through a lot after I became an idol, but I met someone who's genuinely been touched by what I've been trying to do.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks to her, I'm able to keep going as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I wish to become an idol like you and give hope to someone, but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If only I'd debuted with ASRUN sooner, I might've been able to work with you on something.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, that would've been wishful thinking. Even just meeting you would've been enough.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks to you, I overcame whatever was causing me to not smile.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks to you, I was able to change.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I wish I had a chance to tell you that...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But it's time for bed...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? Did my phone just...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm not seeing any new messages, but the way it flashed seemed like...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, could it be...?
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Huh...? There's nobody here...
I thought it was Miku or one of the others calling me over, but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The stage is all lit up, but it's so quiet...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...? My phone flashed again... Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
There's something on the floor.
Is that...? A ball of light...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Did it fall from one of the gantries?
I should move it before someone...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?! S-So bright...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? Where am I...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This looks like...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Like that place from that photo album? But I was in SEKAI just a moment ago...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hold on... I tried to pick up that ball of light I saw on the floor and...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Oh, people?!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
E-Excuse me...
...!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Wait, that person...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: W-Wait! Please wait!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It's her, I'm sure of it.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I know that person from the photo album shouldn't be in a place like this...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But it has to be her...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
A dead-end...?
I could've sworn they came this way.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, please!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's something I need to tell you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No... Another dead-end?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I need to tell her...! I have to tell her...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I have to tell her how she gave me so much hope and that I was able to become an idol because of her...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka, you've given me so much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It was the first time I realized having feelings for someone else could make you so happy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And... And...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka, you gave me my dream of becoming an idol!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I really wasn't sure if I was reaching anyone or spreading hope to them, but...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I knew for sure that I had when I met Minori. I was so happy... Truly, genuinely happy!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She's the reason I was able to get back on my feet. She gave me the courage to do so...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That's why I need to tell you this! I know you're not an idol anymore but I need to tell you...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
Another dead-end...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't see her anywhere...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? A pigeon...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, it has a clover in its mouth...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hello, Mr. Pigeon. Where are you off to today?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What am I saying? It can't possibly understand me...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...? You're giving your clover to me?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's flying in circles above me. What's gotten into it...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Oh, it's moving in that direction now. Does it want me to follow it?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I've lost track of that person...
But standing around here won't change anything.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Where did that pigeon go...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, it's stopped on that window sill.
Is it peering into that house...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, there are so many of them here!
It's so dark, but is this supposed to be their coop?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Huh...? It's too dark to say for sure, but I feel like I've seen this room before...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (This is so strange. It's like I'm being compelled to open this window...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I want to release them from that dark room and let them fly free.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Just as that person did for me...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That pigeon from before is pecking at the window. Its friends can't get out unless I open it.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (All of these pigeons are carrying clovers in their mouths...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Are they all trying to deliver clovers to people too? Like this pigeon did for me?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hang on, I'm opening it now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There, that should...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wah!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, wow...! They're all soaring towards the sky!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
10... 20...?
Hehe. I didn't expect to see so many.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Don't forget to deliver your clovers, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Clovers as a symbol of hope!
So...
Hehe. You too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Wait, this voice...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It's so warm and nostalgic... It's her...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (More importantly, I need to tell her...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Excuse me!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...? Miku?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wh-What happened...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Welcome back, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Um... I was just in this blue city and...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
You must've found a fragment of a feeling, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: In a way, it's another SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Another SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. In SEKAI, fragments of feelings that are yet to manifest as a SEKAI of their own can appear here...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did you happen to find a little ball of light here, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...
After I tried to pick up that ball of light, I found myself in that city.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sure that means you were able to make a connection with someone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I made a connection with someone...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But the only other person there was...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Wait, Miku, you were there too, right?
Did you see that lady?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No. I did go to the city you're talking about, but I didn't see anyone else there...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'm certain that what you saw and heard was all real, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was only there for a brief moment, but I suspect that place was...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Does that mean...?
Hehe. You too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That voice. It was...)
Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That was such a strange experience...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But I wasn't able to tell her what I needed to...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You too, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She gave me her support.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I promise to keep trying my best.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll keep doing everything I can so that I'll be able to tell you just how much hope you gave me, someday...
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I wonder if Miku and the others are here...
Ah...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Good luck!
And give Airi my regards♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh! Hi, girls!
Welcome♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Is Airi with you by chance?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Incidentally, Len just went off to see her about getting some advice concerning his show...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, she isn't with us.
I'm sure he'll be able to see her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Actually, the three of us came here in secret...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, why's that...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Well...
There's something we'd like to discuss with you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Even though she's an idol in her own right, she wasn't seen or lauded as a real idol. That must've been so hard for her to deal with...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sure it was. She was also worried about how she wasn't giving back or delivering hope to anyone...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's why we came here. We want to find a way to cheer her up...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: One idea we had was to have Airi do a special performance on her own.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just her?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. We're pretty certain that the students at the elementary school already know all about her.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we also want her to sing, dance and interact with them to show everyone that she's an idol in every sense of the word.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure Airi would like that as well since it'll give her a chance to spread her wings and show them what a wonderful idol she is.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. That sounds fantastic!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree! Especially since Airi's a total pro when it comes to performing on stage...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It'll be a great opportunity for them to see just how great an idol she really is, no?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it should be♪ Oh, but weren't you already scheduled to perform during this event?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, we'll be performing as a group, but we'll have Airi do an extra show on top of that. At least, that's our plan...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, is there something that might prevent that from happening...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, there are some issues we'll need to work out...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: First, Airi's going to have to practice just that much more since she'll be doing an extra performance...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're still not even sure about what she should sing during this because it's a solo act...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But all of you believe doing a solo performance would yield the greatest benefit for her, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'd also really like to give her a chance to stand proudly on that stage and sing to her heart's content.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too! I've seen how Airi shines on stage and looks so cute when she's up there, so I want everyone else to also see that for themselves!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, I say let's do it...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Like you said, Haruka, we're going to be asking a lot of Airi on top of having to pick the right song for her to sing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But despite all that, you want her to do this, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why don't we put our heads together and try to figure something out?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
We'd be happy to help too♪
Right, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, of course! She means just that much to all of us, so I believe it'll be worth the effort♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And I'm sure Airi will be happy to hear that she'll have more song options to choose from!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So happy that she might just say, Who's gonna say no to more stage time?...♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. That was perfect!
I think she really might!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's because she's an idol who can really inspire hope in others.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right. We all decided that we're gonna spread hope to others, didn't we? That means we have to take on whatever challenges that come our way.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You're right...
There's never just one path.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi, thank you for suggesting this. I... I think I was being a little stubborn.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Oh, I did it again...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you, Miku. You too, Luka, MEIKO. I think I let my stubbornness get the best of me again.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Everything you said is correct. We're not the ones who should be deciding what Airi can or can't do.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's important to understand the risks behind our choices...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we're idols who want to spread hope to everyone, so we should also strive to be able to turn bad into good!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, Shizuku, let's go with this!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me! What if we also did this...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi should get as much time as she needs to practice her song and dance routine, so why don't we do whatever we can to make that happen?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I like that too! We can be in charge of making and gathering props for the quiz and such!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Great idea. The three of us can help reduce her workload by quite a bit if we work together...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That just leaves which song to choose!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. I was hoping to have her sing a song that means something to her. Any ideas...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What if she sang her group's debut track or anything from around the time she was just starting out as an idol...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It can mark the start of a new chapter in her story as an idol♪ And more importantly, as a member of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, that'd be great!
I remember her saying that Rainbow Garland was one of her favorites!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, it is a good idea...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, we also have to think about how we're going to get permission to use these songs.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Exactly. We might not receive permission in time for this event if we have to jump through all those hoops.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sorry, Luka.
It's such a nice idea too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Don't mind me♪ Rules are rules.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What if you asked one of the higher-ups directly? Wouldn't that be the fastest way of getting permission?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ask them directly...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
One of the higher-ups...?
Like one of the writers...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Huh? Y-Yeah...
I guess that's one way to go about this...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, I know...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Do you have a lead?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I believe I do...!
Please, leave this one to me!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, it's all yours!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But don't be afraid to ask for help if you run into any trouble, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you! I promise!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So how are we gonna tell her all this...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'll have to work out what we'll be doing for our sneak preview, how to reveal what Airi's going to be doing as well as any other relevant details.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If we are actually going to announce this during our event preview, we really don't have much time to prepare.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm sure we'll make it in time as long as we work together!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. I'll do everything I can if it means helping Airi!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We'll be there for you too if you need us!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you all so much. We really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Airi's always looking after us to make sure we function well as a group.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She really knows how to keep conversations going and when to throw in a joke or two...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She's become the foundation on which our group stands because of all that.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And now, it's our turn to help her...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's do everything we can for Airi!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, good morning, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Morning, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Were you practicing on the rooftop this morning? I think I caught a glimpse of you guys.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, that was us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Um... Can I ask you another question?
Did Airi come to school today?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Huh? Airi?
Yes, she was practicing with us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She seems anxious...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Oh, I think I know why...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Would you like to meet Airi?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! H-How did you know?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I've been blessed enough to be able to meet quite a few of my fans up to this point.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As a result, I can sort of tell what a person's thinking based on their facial expression.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Y-You can...?!
That's amazing, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
C-Can I really meet her...?
There's something I really want to tell her!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure. I'll ask Airi to set aside some time before we practice during lunch.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Awesome! Thank you so much!!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
