rows.Line:
She learned all that just for us?
I'll have to thank her when I see her at school tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
The first picture is...
Oh, it's us having dessert at the diner.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're right! Those were so yummy too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. Kohane was really regretting not taking pictures of you trying on clothes at that street fashion place.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But she had to make sure not to because it's usually against store policy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. I'm glad she thought I looked good in that outfit.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Of course you looked good!
Conversely, is there anything you don't look good in?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What? I really don't think that's the case.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Are you sure? I would've taken as many pictures of you as I could have if I was allowed to.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'll never forget what I saw that day!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm...? Are these stickers in the background?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh wow! They're stars and hearts! That's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's so cool! I didn't know you could edit photos like this!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me neither. These do a really nice job of showing how fun that was too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I think these are the ones from Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Oh, look! This is when we went on the merry-go-round together, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also... I think she took these in continuous mode. Look, it's like we're moving frame by frame.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. It's like Kohane's a professional photographer!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She just might be. She captured all these great expressions too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She must have a talent for picturing people in the best light possible.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Haruka, look at this one!
It's the cutout where you can be Phenny!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Haha... Oh geez...
I look like I'm in my own little world...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. But you're making such a cute face.
Great choice, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Does this mean I was able to relax a little?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The face I'm making here's really embarrassing, but it looks like I was genuinely enjoying myself...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, our stream or anything of the sort came up much during conversations when I was with them.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Whenever I'm by myself, I seem to naturally gravitate towards my idol persona...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But I feel like I can just be myself when I'm around An.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I guess it's because she knows the real me.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (No, it isn't just that...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hm? Haruka, is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I was just thinking that I must've been able to really relax based on the face I'm making here.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And I have you and the others to thank for giving me that opportunity, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'm really happy that I got to hear more from An about Haruka Kiritani before she became an idol.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's something I'll never ever forget both as your fan and as your friend!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I suppose that means you're the reason I was able to have so much fun...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because you're my dear friend too, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: On our way home that day, you mentioned how you didn't know anything about me before I became an idol.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But if you think about it, An doesn't really know much about me after I'd become one.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Instead, someone right under my nose was doing her best to learn as much as she could about me...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That person's you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*...
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And you want to know more about me than anybody else, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka...!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I'm gonna do everything I can! I'll follow you wherever and learn absolutely everything about you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Every time she says that...
It makes my heart tickle...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And I couldn't be happier...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I can't thank you enough, Minori.
Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm glad our event succeeded.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (There are a few things that we need to work on, but we should be able to go into our next one with our heads held high.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But for now, I need to work on that segment for our next stream...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hm? A message...?
Oh, it's from Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <I'd like to talk before practice tomorrow morning.> ...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Did something happen...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I mean, I'll reply yes but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (What does she want to talk about?)
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka! Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sorry about asking you to meet like this so suddenly.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, it's okay. Thirty minutes earlier than usual is no big deal.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But what is it that you want to talk about?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Putting on that event we just did really taught me that I still don't have enough knowledge or experience yet when it comes to these things.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see now that what I sometimes think of as being good can be not so great for our fans. I wasn't able to see things from a different perspective before...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I can't believe someone's willing to help us like this! Now, our event might just...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is this the right way to go?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By agreeing to have this person help us, we'd be making them “work” instead of having fun, no...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In other words, we'd be forcing our fans to face reality and see what goes on behind the scenes...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I want to do everything in my power to make sure our fans get to enjoy our events as fans.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I apologize for what I said that time, Minori. You were so optimistic and looking forward to everything, while I just...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What? N-No, don't worry about that!
I should be apologizing for not fully understanding how our fans would feel about what I said!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, well...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'd like to take more of that into consideration when we're planning for our next event.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So I want you to tell me more about where you think I need to be more careful moving forward!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, and I'll try my best to give you good feedback.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let me start by commending you on wanting to be more “careful” since it's a very important part of what we do.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's easy to miss things that you shouldn't be by not giving something the attention it deserves.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In terms of knowledge, I can tell you about some things, but I gave a feeling that Airi's the better person to ask.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She was a regular on quite a few TV shows, so she probably knows more than any of us about how the production process really works.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right! I really appreciate it, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As for experience, that's just going to take time for you to accrue.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, yeah... I guess so, huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I used to be the “zero experience amateur idol”, so I'm not about to let that get me down!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I want to keep learning more about being an idol by gaining that experience with all of you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But Minori...
You do possess something really incredible.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! I... I do?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You have the ability to see things from the fans' perspective.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because you'd spent so much time being my fan, you really know what the fans want.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's something the rest of us won't be able to achieve any time soon even if we tried.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I believe that the time you spent and the experience you gained as a fan, is just as important as the time the rest of us spent being idols.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So I really want you to be proud of having the ability to see things from the fans' perspective.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: When we're trying to think of ideas for our stream, Airi's always saying how, “It's important to see things from the fans' perspective.”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And now I understand. I actually have something to contribute...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Exactly. So I'd like it if you could also keep taking what you believe into consideration as well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I believe you'll get to experience a whole variety of things before you know it if you do, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, I'll start by thinking about what I can do for us! Thank you so much, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad I asked you about this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Likewise.
Thank you as well for taking what I said so seriously.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hello... Oh, Airi, are you the only one up here?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, Shizuku's on classroom duty today, so she's gonna be running a little late.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see.
Oh, it's Minori turn to take care of the animals today, so she'll be running late too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start with some stretches...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sorry for being late.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, Shizuku. You're earlier than expected.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Luckily, all I had to do was write my entry in the class log and take it to the teachers.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, that just leaves Minori.
We can stretch while we wait for her.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, mind if I ask you two something while we stretch?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Why don't we look back upon our event a little during our next stream's talk segment?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure many of our viewers weren't able to join us and would very much like to know what happened.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Nice idea! That'd be perfect since we built this event from the ground up with our fans.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it'd also be nice to thank them along with everyone else who came to see us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Honestly, I'm so glad it ended up being a success.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. We definitely had some tense moments leading up to it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, the day of the event didn't exactly go as planned, but it became really fun after we found a place of understanding...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, also...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It was so nice to see how everyone who volunteered to become staff genuinely wanted to see our event succeed.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know, right? That was really what kept us together...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Ultimately, our event had a cozy, homemade feel to it, which I really liked.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I totally agree! I'm not sure if it was because of that, but everyone seemed to be all warmed up by the time we started the talk portion.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And after that, the whole place went crazy during the mini-concert! It's like everything fell into place perfectly!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess that's what people call “synergy”...? Anyway, things really did fall into place nicely.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. This event might not have been possible if Minori didn't suggest so strongly that we try to make it happen.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Putting on that event we just did really taught me that I still don't have enough knowledge or experience yet when it comes to these things.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see now that what I sometimes think of as being good can be not so great for our fans. I wasn't able to see things from a different perspective before...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori mentioned how she wished she put more thought into her actions...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But at the same time, I believe she's the reason we were able to work with our fans and make this event possible.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If Minori learns how to couple her ideas with some risk management, I have a feeling that she'll start growing by leaps and bounds.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. And we'll have to learn more about seeing things from our fans' perspective from her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, she's definitely the best person here to teach us how.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sorry for being so late!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, there's our teacher!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure you're tired from committee work, Ms. Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? M-Ms. Minori?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. It's not good to tease a teacher like that, you two.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-You too, Haruka?!
Why am I a teacher now?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Because what?
Stop laughing and tell me already, you guys!
Shrine Hall

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Now that we've learned the proper etiquette for being shrine maidens, let's give it our best shot!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's make sure everyone who visits is able to fondly look back upon this past year and look forward to the next one!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Oh, but there's something I need to ask you all to do...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We've lightly disguised ourselves just in case this time...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But in the event that some of our fans do realize who we are, please tell them that, “We're volunteering here on our own time.”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Good idea. We may also want to ask them to refrain from taking pictures and posting them online.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay!
We wouldn't want to cause the shrine or its visitors any trouble so...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. I'm sure they'll understand as long as we ask them politely.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Still, Haruka, your fans are gonna be so surprised when they see you here... Dressed as a shrine maiden no less...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Some might even think that this is a shrine dedicated to you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A shrine dedicated to Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Well, I mean...
Kiritani Shrine

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, we're here!
I'm gonna make so many wishes this year!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hm? Wait, is that...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
H-Haruka?!
What are you doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This is the Kiritani Shrine, so it's only natural for me to be here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-What?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-Is this my reward for working so hard this past year...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Why don't I make a wish with you?
Oh, I could ask for you to have another great year.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Something like that...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That didn't make any sense at all!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You have such a vivid imagination, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, doesn't a shrine dedicated to Haruka means that there'd also be a festival to celebrate her?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
A Haruka festival?!
That'd be amazing!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wouldn't it also be fun to dance and parade around while carrying a little shrine in her honor?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, it absolutely would be!
Oh, what if we had lanterns that look like penguins!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we could even wave around blue glow sticks and offer delicious sweets in celebration.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We'll need lots of merch too, like charms and ceremonial arrows in Haruka's image...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Merch...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You've gone from being a shrine maiden to a goddess...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Do you have any words to offer your overzealous followers, your divineness?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm the furthest thing from divine, but alright... Ahem...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Minori, Shizuku...
Hear my words.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Eep!
Th-That voice...!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's the great Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
This is hallowed ground...
You must behave accordingly as the shrine maidens you are.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you!
We will!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We promise not to disappoint!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hah!
Seriously? None of you came up with a punchline for that?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Haha. Sorry about that, you two. Our divine comedy tragically must come to an end.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe... That actually helped me a lot, Haruka! I feel like I can make it through today now!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I feel the same way!
If anything, I'm more inclined to do my part as a shrine maiden now!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's good to hear.
But I feel a little embarrassed about my performance just now... I hope no one up there was watching...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But it worked, didn't it?
That's Haruka Kiritani for you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Anyway, we should head over soon.
Shall we?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(A shrine dedicated to me...
I really don't deserve anything like that...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I just want to make it so all these hopeful visitors get to make their wishes today.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, let's give it everything we have today! Ready?

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!
Shrine Hall

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm starting to get the hang of being a shrine maiden.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It seems much calmer out there now, so I should be able to check in with the others to see how they're doing.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Huh...?
I see someone hunched over. I hope they're okay.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It's a girl. She looks around our age. Maybe younger... But I'm not seeing any friends or family members. Is she all alone out here?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
E-Excuse me.
Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...
I'm just a little tired...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see...
But you don't look so well. I think you should rest for a little while.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's a bench right over there where we can sit. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I really appreciate it. I feel much better now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's good to hear.
You really didn't look well back there.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm? Are you sure you're okay now? Is something still bothering you...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: N-No, it's not that...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I don't know if I should be asking a shrine maiden about this but...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I... I ran away from home...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
What?
Why...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: My parents and I got into a fight over my future...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
I really love baking...
So I brought up the idea of me going to a vocational school where I can learn to be a patisserie.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: They rejected me by saying I have my head in the clouds...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
That's why I came here.
My wish is to make it so they'll say yes to my decision.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I see.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: But I can't actually wish this away, can I...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I believe the opposite...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I believe any wish can be granted as long as you have faith in it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By the way, do you have an idea of what it's like to be a patisserie...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Yeah, I did some research online, and even asked around at some local bakeries and cake shops.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: They told me that I have to have the mental and physical stamina to be able to cope with a long and arduous process that doesn't always reward you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Mental and physical stamina...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That reminds me of the time a professional pastry chef came to teach ASRUN how to make cakes. They mentioned the exact same thing.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (For a time, they were only allowed to clean and check inventory. And when it got busy, they hardly had enough time to get any sleep.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But they're always able to get through all of that because they know somebody's waiting for their cake to arrive on their special day.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Would you mind me asking why you decided to want to become a patisserie in the first place...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Huh?
Why...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Your parents told you that you have your “head in the clouds”, no?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What if they just don't fully know or understand your reasoning behind wanting to become a patisserie? Wouldn't that help convince them of your decision?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: *Gasp*...!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: You're right. I don't think I explained everything to them well enough...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If that's the case, I believe you'll have no problem getting them to understand.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Now I see what they meant by what they said...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: One year, I made my mom a birthday cake and she really loved it. I still remember the way she smiled like it happened yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I know that's what I need to tell them now...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, and I'm sure you'll do a wonderful job.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
A-Again, thank you so much...
I'm so glad I came here today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Likewise. I'm glad that I could help.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But it's starting to get dark, so please watch your step.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
I will!
Bye, and thanks again!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I hope I didn't pry too much...
Still...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I hope her dream comes true...)

rows.Speaker: Shrine Visitor
rows.Line:
E-Excuse me!
Could you point me towards the shrine office?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes...!
It's right this way!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Humhumhum♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You sound like you're in a good mood, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Because I can't wait for our design competition!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. When I get home later, I'm gonna go over all the outfits I've drawn up until now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku

rows.Line: (She's so incredible...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka

rows.Line: (Minori's an idol who has the support and adoration of all these people.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But you kept persevering, Minori.
As a result, you gave us an enormous amount of hope and encouragement.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's the reason why I'm so happy to be standing on this stage with you today. Because I know this solo show is your big moment.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:

Together!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:

rows.Line: Hey, you seem awfully energetic today. I remember a certain someone being completely wiped after that first show we did with Nanamin.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-That happened because I was taken by the moment...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You also seemed a bit dizzy after that fan event we did the other day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah. The same thing happened there...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I somehow managed to keep it together during today's show!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, we kinda need you to not lose consciousness during these events, you know!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Still, we all knew this was going to be a big show, and you ended up doing a wonderful job.

rows.Speaker: Minori

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: From the second we started to when we began singing... When I waved at the audience as we greeted them... Everything.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The smiles I saw on everyone's faces, all their cheers... It's still clear in my head.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think it's a sign that the events and shows we've done up to this point have given you the experience you need to succeed.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. Also, you seemed to figure out a good way to prepare yourself mentally for today's show. We really couldn't have asked for better results.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. Honestly, you were a nervous wreck during the week leading up to our show. I can't believe how you went from that to this. Nice work!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you all so much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um, and...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Once again... Thank you, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, remember what you said during the show?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You said, “Let's keep doing our best. Together.” That made me so happy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm really glad.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
In that case, Minori...
Let's keep singing for as long as we can together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
Oh, wait! That reminds me...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Just out of curiosity...
Do you remember what happened during “HONEY” when you were touring Japan...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hmm... Maybe?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? That grin...
Is that a yes or a no?! Please tell me!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh geez. Well, I guess that's just the way they are...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehehe.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Our animal cafe's gonna look so cute!

rows.Line:
(Oh, they also brought some bags.
But it doesn't look like they're full of plushies...)

rows.Line: I bought some animal ear headbands after Saki suggested that we should. I'm a little embarrassed about wearing one, but shall we try them on together?

rows.Line: Animal headbands?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
Here, have a look!

rows.Line:

I'm seeing rabbit ears, dog ears, cat ears... They're all very cute.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right?!

rows.Line: Saki was saying how we should dress up as animals since our classroom's going to be filled with them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That makes sense. We're doing an animal cafe, so it might be fun for everyone in class to be dressed as different ones.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Having everyone wear these adorably furry ears is such a great idea if I do say so myself♪

rows.Line:
We even got some tails!
Hang on... Here! You can be a doggy or a kitty!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, they're really fluffy too.
They almost feel like the real thing.

rows.Line: Wanna try one on? All you really have to do is put on a headband and the belt for the tail!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Okay, one second.

rows.Line:

rows.Line:
Perfect!
They both suit you really well.

rows.Line: L-Like a cat?

rows.Line: A cat, huh... M-Meow...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: W-Welcome...meow...?

rows.Line: Whoa! That was amazing!!!

rows.Line:
It was?

rows.Line: Try harder...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
“Welcomeow♪

rows.Line: Um... Is something wrong, you two?

rows.Line: Y-You're...

rows.Line: Blindingly bright!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: How do I describe it?! It's like we were just swept away by a torrent of happiness and sunshine!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... This must be what Minori's always talking about. Kiritani's idol aura...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You're exaggerating.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: I agree... Also, I'm not sure I could do that even if someone asked me to...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, right... Some people might not feel all that comfortable with talking like a cat or dog.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The ears and tails are already plenty cute, so why don't we just talk normally to our customers?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Line: Thank you for trying them on for us, Kiritani. You taught us quite a lot just now.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Huh? Hey, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Huh? An?
What brings you here?

rows.Line: Dad asked me to go out and buy some stuff. I was just about to head over to the station.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Are you on your way home, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm going to the station too.
Why don't we head there together?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Actually, I was about to ask you the same thing!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I had a feeling.
Then, shall we?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You looked like you had something on your mind just now. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, not really. I was just reminiscing about all the fun I had during the School Festival.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
If that's the case, you should be smiling more.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wouldn't it seem a bit strange if I just started laughing to myself in public, even if I was thinking about some fun memories...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, I didn't know that a certain friend of mine would call out to me soon afterwards because they were worried.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What would you do without me?
Is what I would've said, but I noticed the look on your face after I called out to you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I honestly just happened to see you walking by and decided to ask where you were going.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, we're best friends, but I can't exactly tell how you're feeling just by seeing your back.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, you can't? What kind of best friend are you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, Miss Perfect, try telling how I feel just based on my back.

rows.Speaker: Haruka & An
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, I had a ton of fun during the Miya Girls School Festival.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Despite getting chased all around campus by a zombie wolf?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Gulp*
You know about that too...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course. You thought I didn't?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Remember how you dove into my class and left a second later while Kohane was chasing you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? I did?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, you did. But you were so desperate to get away from the zombie wolf that I didn't get a chance to ask you what was going on.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hang on. Your class did that animal cafe, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that explains why it seemed so familiar when I went with Kohane and the others later!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: An... I guess you were genuinely terrified.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: At the same time, a zombie wolf's completely different from a ghost. Why did it scare you so much?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Why?! I mean, that mask...
It looked so real!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I learned beforehand that Kohane's class would be doing a haunted house, so I tried my best to prepare myself mentally for it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I don't like what I don't like!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By the way, how did you prepare yourself for it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well... I tried telling myself that things are gonna jump out at me and that they're people, not monsters...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. However...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. It didn't work, did it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Cut me some slack.
I was sure that my plan would work!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Seriously, I wasn't expecting to run into a zombie wolf right off the bat...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, I guess that makes sense...
A surprise like that would throw anyone into a panic.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Exactly!
I never would've seen that coming!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, it is a haunted house, so that's not really an excuse...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I'm glad you got to enjoy it in the end.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Same. My heart raced because of how scary it was, but I guess that's sorta what haunted houses are all about.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, I'm glad that I got to enjoy it as an actual haunted house.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, why don't you try the haunted house at PXL the next time you visit?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's pretty similar to the haunted house that Kohane's class made, so I'm sure you'll be fine, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're joking! That haunted house isn't as scary as I thought it was going to be?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It really isn't. You become Phenny as he has a nightmare that's filled with skeletons who keep saying that they're going to “fry you up”.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! Fry you up?! Like chicken?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm not kidding. Some even talked about frying you up like “yummy wings” and “juicy tenders”.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I heard that there's even one that says, “I'm gonna turn you into bang bang chicken!” If you find it, something good's supposed to happen.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?! I've never heard of anything like that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's probably because you usually cover your ears when people talk about this kind of stuff.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, yeah. True...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. The next time we get to go to PXL with Minori and Kohane, we can give the haunted house a try.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, okay! I actually might be okay based on your explanation!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: See? Then, let's all go again sometime.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Line:

rows.Line:
Hello.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:

rows.Line:
O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: But I saw this shop with really cute plushies... Then, when I went to go see them, she disappeared.

rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Did she keep walking without realizing that her little sister wasn't following her...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Does your sister have a phone on her? If you know her number, I could try calling her...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
No, she doesn't...
But she did tell me to come here if I ever did get lost.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I think she's around five...
I wonder how old her sister is.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Also, she promised to wait here if anything happened, so I probably shouldn't take her to mall security...)

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: When's Sis gonna come...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
I'm sure your sister will come very soon. So, until she does, I'll stay here with you.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Y-You will...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes. My name's Haruka.
Can you tell me yours...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Nozomi...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Nozomi? Got it. Alright, Nozomi, why don't I teach you some special magic words?

rows.Speaker: Nozomi
rows.Line: Magic words...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. First, you place your index fingers on your cheeks, and then you...do a fist pump!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And the magic words for this are, “Poke your cheeks and pose and smile!”

rows.Speaker: Nozomi
rows.Line: Wow, that sounds like some kind of spell.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Would you like to try it with me, Nozomi? Here we go.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Poke your cheeks and pose and smile♪

rows.Speaker: Nozomi
rows.Line: Poke your cheeks...and pose and... Smile!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Nice! That was a wonderful smile.

rows.Speaker: Nozomi
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Nozomi
rows.Line: Hey, Haruka, where did you learn these magic words?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Well...
Nozomi! Where are you?!

rows.Speaker: Nozomi
rows.Line: Oh, it's Sis!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank goodness. Your sister came looking for you.

rows.Speaker: Nozomi
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks for hanging out with me, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Nozomi's Sister
rows.Line: Nozomi! Why'd you disappear like that?! You almost made my heart stop!

rows.Speaker: Nozomi
rows.Line: I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Nozomi's Sister
rows.Line: Oh dear...were you okay? You must've been so lonely...

rows.Speaker: Nozomi
rows.Line:
Yeah, a little...
But I got to hang out with Haruka, and she even taught me some fun magic words!

rows.Speaker: Nozomi's Sister
rows.Line: Thank you so much for watching my little sister.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
I'm glad your sister came looking for you like you said, Nozomi. But promise not to get lost again, okay?

rows.Speaker: Nozomi
rows.Line: I promise! Thanks for hanging out with me, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course, take care.

rows.Speaker: Nozomi's Sister
rows.Line:
Again, I can't thank you enough!
Wait a second...? Haruka...? As in...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Haruka!
You're here early!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry about the wait. Unfortunately, Minori and I had to help a certain someone here after we spotted her walking in the wrong direction.

rows.Line: Which saved me from getting lost. However, we ended up making you wait, Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
Actually, that's funny... While I waited, I also had the opportunity to lend somebody a hand.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Lend somebody a hand?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Anyway, now that we're all here, shall we?

rows.Line: Okay, it should be all set up now...

rows.Line: I had no idea that an app that lets you listen to radio stations from around the country existed. I really need to thank Minori for telling me about this.

rows.Line: Oh, Haruka, do you know the name of your hero's radio program? I really wanna listen to it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I do... But her stations are in another part of the country, and I don't think you can find it online either.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, what about an app?
It might be available there.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? An app?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, this one... There's no background noise and it lets you listen to radio stations from around the country!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really? I had no idea this kind of app existed...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Remember how you and the others sometimes used to do radio commercials for when you went to do shows in other parts of the country?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I really wanted to listen to them, so I did some research and found something that would let me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I'm sure this app should let you listen to your hero's radio program!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I wonder what kind of program it is.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Also, her voice. I'm really curious as to what she sounds like now. It might've changed quite a lot since then.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's time...

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line:
<Hello, listeners!
It's time for another installment of “Smiling News Bulletin”! As usual, we'll be bringing you news from all over the region this week♪>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It's her...!)

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: <It's been getting very chilly lately, so I hope you're all staying warm out there. Actually, it's been getting so cold that I've been trying to figure out a way to commute to work without leaving my kotatsu!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She's still as cheerful and talkative as ever, and her voice is so nice to listen to. She still speaks like the way I remember.)

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: <Incidentally, I was invited to appear at a fall festival that was being held within the region just the other day, and I had a chance to sing a few songs.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: <The children who were there all sang and danced along with me, it was so much fun.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: <My goal was to make sure everyone there enjoyed themselves, but their energy was just so infectious that I was the one filled with cheer!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She did a performance...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I'm sure she made everybody smile...
Just like she did back then.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I wish I could've been there to see her perform...)

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: <Oh, speaking of which... During that performance, something really great happened for me personally.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: <One of the children who joined me on stage came up to me and said, “I wanna perform on stage just like you someday.”>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: <That reminded me of a little girl who said the same thing to me when I performed at this one shopping mall in Tokyo when I was still an idol.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Is she talking about...?)

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: <Dreams are so wonderful. They may be far in the future, but they're all beautiful because they can be whatever you want them to be.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: <Like a boundless ocean under a clear sky.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: <And I feel blessed knowing that I'm still able to spread hope for a better tomorrow to others in that manner.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line:
<Hehe. Listen to me...
I'm such a sap.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's still an incredible person...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She may not be an idol anymore, but she's still able to spread hope to others like before...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I wouldn't be an idol right now if it wasn't for her...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(No, it goes beyond that.
I wouldn't have learned how to smile if it weren't for her.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you so much...
For making me who I am.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: <That's it for this week. Thirty minutes never feels like enough time, but I hope you all enjoyed the program.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: <Next week, we'll be bringing you some more fun news, so I hope you'll tune in.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line:
<Keep smiling until then.
See you next time♪>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Wow...
Thirty minutes flew by just like that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (My chest is filled with so much warmth. It might be because I know that she's doing well now.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She made me believe in a better tomorrow. Again.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, that means I need to also keep trying my best.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka, good morning.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Morning, Shizuku. You're here early.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I thought I should review the script again since our shoot is coming up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I want it to go well since it'll be our first time appearing on TV as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She seems pretty motivated.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And it's not just us she's worried about...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I had no right being the lead in the first place. Especially since I couldn't do anything for the others and ended up leaving the group...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, since we've been given an opportunity to appear on TV alongside Cheerful * Days, I'd like to make the most of it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I have to make up for what happened back then...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's do our best and figure out a way to make our shoot a good one when we appear with everyone from Cheerful * Days.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like that very much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: At the same time, I feel so bad about this...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's our first time appearing on TV, but I'm making you all worry about me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We understand, Shizuku...
However, we chose to appear on iHaz as a group.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, there's no turning back.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm such a mess...
If only I were a stronger person.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think you already are, Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Remember what we talked about on that one program we were on together? You had just been chosen to be the lead for Cheerful * Days.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course I remember.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You really are amazing.
The best of the best. It's like you're shining even brighter in person than when I see you on TV...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I want to meet my fans' expectations too, but I'm not sure I can get myself to do what you do, Kiritani...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure you can, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You thinking this hard about what you can do for your groupmates and fans means that you're trying your best.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Being the lead means there will be added pressure and responsibilities compared to everybody else...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I'm sure you'll be just fine, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I had so little confidence in myself back then, which led to you having to cheer me up, Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, is that how you saw our conversation...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Did you see it a different way...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I meant what I said that time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It was clear to me that you genuinely cared about your fans and were doing your best for them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The way you sang and performed was proof of that fact. Your hard work speaks for itself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know you did your best to take responsibility as the lead. I also know that it was hard. So hard that it occasionally brought you to tears.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But despite all that pain, you kept trying. You didn't run away.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That means you're not a weak person.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, you may see our first TV appearance involving Cheerful * Days as a bad omen of sorts... But I actually think it's a good thing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I had a feeling that this would've happened sooner or later anyway. And what happened with Cheerful * Days still weighs on your mind, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, in order for you to just be yourself moving forward, I think it's good that you're being given an opportunity to clear the air now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
So I can be myself...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're saying that... Just as I can't be like you, Airi or Minori, none of you can be like me, yes?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Exactly. You have a number of qualities that only you possess, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, I'd like it if we could work together and push each other forward.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Me too...!
Thank you, Haruka.
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Welcome, girls♪
Are you here to practice?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh...
Hehe. You're all smiling. That must mean you've got some good news for us.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, wait...!
Does this mean your episode of iHaz aired?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right! Good call, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We heard that your shoot went well, but it finally aired?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
How was it?
I hope they didn't edit it in a funny way.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We appreciate your concern, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But there's no need to worry...
Actually, maybe I shouldn't say it. I think we'd rather have you see for yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, you should've seen Shizuku! She was so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She was?! Hehe. I can't wait to see.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, we'll need to set up a place where we can watch it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I've made it so we can play videos on the stage's big display! Here, use this cord!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: KAITO, when did you...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Excellent work♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you very much, KAITO.
I'll play it now.

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line:
<So, let's bring in our guests!
Give a big round of applause for MORE MORE JUMP!>

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: <Aren't your fans from when you were still in Cheerful * Days going to be disappointed?>

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: <More to the point, Shizuku, tell us. Which one is the real you?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
<However, I chose to just be myself.
Which...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Which made me realize how there are some things that only the real me had to offer. And I found that some were willing to accept me for who I really am...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <So, even if I end up disappointing some of my old fans, I'm going to keep doing my best to spread hope to as many people as I can... As myself.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Th-That was awesome...!
I was so moved!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, me too.
I started tearing up a little while listening to your story, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Me three. I'm sure your fans felt glad that they kept supporting you all this time after hearing what you said.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you should've seen the response she got!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know, right?! We got so many messages saying, “I saw iHaz!” and “You're the best, Shizuku! What you did was so cool!” We still haven't gotten a chance to read all of them yet.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad for you, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
A job well done, Haruka.
And you too, Airi. You both did a wonderful job of supporting her.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I really need to thank you again...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It was because of you I was able to make that decision to appear on TV, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As your fan, I want to say, “Don't worry.”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Including the hope and warmth you wish to spread to others.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And those things mean quite a lot to me...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, a TV appearance isn't going to easily change how I feel about all of you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why you decided to become an idol in the first place or how you felt back then...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, now might not be a bad time to look back on all that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It was because of your words, we all got to take this big step forward.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you very much, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome♪
Aboard a Train

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi, about this email...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, that. I replied the first time, so I'll also handle it this time around.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They're going through our emails at a pretty good pace. It's nice that them taking care of all that is giving us time to study...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But we did just finish doing a shoot...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Minori, can I turn to the next page...?
Or would you like to take a little break instead?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?! N-No, I'm okay...!
Please, turn to the next page!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Are you sure? Then...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When the Onin War broke out in 1467, the head of the shogunate at the time was Ashikaga Yoshimasa...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(She still seems a little sleepy...
Oh, in that case...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, I have an idea.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: An idea?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. It's hard to remember names and dates just from reading the textbook, so why don't we turn it into a game where we ask each other questions?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our quiz is supposed to be all fill-in-the-blank, so it should help us prepare for it...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds fun!
I wanna give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks. Then, we'll cover what we'll be quizzed on. That's from the middle of the Muromachi period to the beginning of the Sengoku period.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's choose questions based on that and quiz each other.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! Then, Haruka, you start!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When the Onin War broke out, the shogun at the time was _____. Whose name goes in the blank?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, you just read that part a second ago. Um, it was... Ashikaga Yoshi...Yoshimasa!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Correct! You ask next, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay. Umm...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: In 1485, in what is known today as Kyoto, a large uprising known as the _____ occurred. What was it called?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The Yamashiro uprising.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Correct! That's amazing! You got it so fast!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Why don't we try some harder questions next?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
In _____, the Meio Coup occurred.
What year was that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that event sounds familiar, but I don't remember the year... Uhh... 1490!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Close! It was 1493.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Grr, darn...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
History's hard enough since we have to remember all these people with really similar names. But we have to memorize dates on top of that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mnemonics might make things easier.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For example, the Onin War started in 1467 because of a “vain act by man”, or “hito yo munashii” in Japanese.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I remember doing those in junior high. “The nightingale cries in Heian-kyo” was one of them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, the Meio Coup took place in 1493, so... I-shi-ku-san...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, “Shizuku's a lovely person”!
“Ii Shizuku-san” in Japanese...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hm? Did I do something?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. We were just coming up with mnemonics for historical dates.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I see. Then, based on what you just said, you were referring to... 1...? 1...493...? So, 11493? Oh dear...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's way in the future...
The answer's probably 1493, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, it is.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, but it doesn't really work since it doesn't tie itself to the Meio Coup.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In those situations, you just gotta memorize it however you can.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree, since the ideas you come up with yourself are likely much easier to remember.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You think so? Then, I might just go with Shizuku being a lovely person.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi, since we've checked this many emails already, why don't we help Haruka and Minori study for their quiz?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, sounds good...
The Meio Coup means you're in the Muromachi period?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. Our quiz is supposed to cover everything from the middle of that period up until the beginning of the Sengoku period.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that time in history's tough because of all the battles and people who were involved...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. I remember having such a difficult time learning from just my textbook that I borrowed historical manga and novels from the library to try to remember everything.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Historical novels... Hehe. That's a good idea since you like to read so much, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Novels aren't always necessarily true to life, but they definitely made it much easier for me to imagine who these people were and what caused them to come into conflict.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, the diagrams they have in encyclopedic references are also really helpful.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's always nice to see them plainly lay out how certain events led to future events while this other thing was happening over here and such.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. Lugging them around wouldn't have been easy, but I wish I'd brought some along on this trip since I knew I wanted to study.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry, Minori, but we'll just have to make do with my textbook for now...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. She's sound asleep.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She did give it everything she had today. We should let her rest.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Mhm...
Shizuku, Airi, Haruka... You're all so lovely...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Is she dreaming about the mnemonic she just came up with?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think so.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Even in her dreams, she's doing the best she can. I think I'll try to come up with some mnemonics while she sleeps.)
Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Haruka & Saki
rows.Line: That was delicious.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for sharing some of your lunch with me, Tenma. Those little omelets were really good.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're welcome♪ Your family's potato salad was also really good, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You really love swapping entrees, huh, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. It feels like we're on a field trip that way!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. That reminds me of the time I swapped entrees and snacks with my friends during a field trip in elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Speaking of which, our school's field trip is coming up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know! I can't wait! I'm sooo excited♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Where do you think we get to go this year?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It was PXL last year!
That's what the seniors in my club told me♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's supposed to change every year, so I'm guessing it's gonna be somewhere other than PXL...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Like a different amusement park?
Or the mountains? Or the beach?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hmm... The mountains would be a nice choice, but I'm a little doubtful since there usually aren't many different trails... There wouldn't be much point in having us break into small groups.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right... Our groups for the Seaside School included people from different classes, but it's just gonna be our classmates this time around, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! We get to talk about what we're gonna do during our free time, where we're gonna visit, what we're gonna eat and chat like there's no tomorrow...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is the best part of school! This is the definition of enjoying our youth♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm really excited too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (This will probably be the last school event that I get to participate in with my classmates...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haruka, you got this!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Good luck, Kiritani!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Um, Kiritani? Do you have a minute?
I wanted to give you this to say thank you for running in my place the other day.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you! I was too busy with work when this was on sale, so I wasn't able to get one!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: I'm glad you like it.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Um... I was also wondering...
Would you like to hang out after school some time?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure, I'd love to.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The Sports Festival gave me a chance to get to know my classmates better...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And we got to run a cafe together during the School Festival...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Haruka, is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, are you still hungry?
I have some gummies! Wanna try those?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I'll take one if you don't mind. Thanks, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're welcome. How about you, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm okay.
Actually, why do you have those?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because I wanted to eat them, silly♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (After I return to the credit-based course, I won't be able to have lunch or chat with them as much...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But Tenma and the others have helped me create all these wonderful memories of high school...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Oh, Haruka, you guys!
Our next class isn't math! It's being switched to music!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Wait, really?
Thanks for telling us!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Sure thing! See you in class!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If we're having music next... Wait, that means we're switching classrooms!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. We should head back to get our textbooks and things.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Man, why couldn't the teachers have told us sooner? We gotta clean up here fast!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, you dropped a chopstick.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Where'd it go?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Here. But we don't need to rush since the warning bell hasn't rung yet.

rows.Speaker: Haruka

rows.Line: Aquariums have all sorts of cuddly creatures...like penguins.

rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You really like penguins, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I do. Getting to pet all those little critters made me want to pet some penguins too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Does the aquarium let you do that?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Only during special events they hold occasionally.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
And you get to touch them...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Why don't we go together the next time they hold one of those events, Hinomori...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, I want—

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: At the same time... I'm a little worried about how you're going to react.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To what?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The thing is, in the face of real-life penguins... I sort of lose sight of everything else.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You can get tunnel vision like that, Kiritani?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, and if they all flock towards me...
Well, something embarrassing might happen.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I kinda want to see that now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, even for an event, I doubt they'd let you play with a whole flock of penguins all at once. Not unless you're actually taking care of them...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As part of the aquarium staff...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How could I've been so oblivious? I might have to see if they'll let us shadow...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, I was kidding.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In any case, I'm going to go sate my penguin craving in a different way today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A different way?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was thinking about stopping by the Penguin Cafe. They don't have real penguins, but the atmosphere should be more than enough.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, that's what you were talking about going before you head home...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Seeing all those cute little animals today made me want to cap off the day by seeing some penguins.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see. Now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I won some penguin merch in a prize draw that one time, and I'm pretty sure it said online that the Penguin Cafe has new stuff from that brand...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Would you like to come with me, Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I... I guess their menu's probably changed since the last time I went, so it might be nice to go back again...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, I wanna see what happens to you when you're surrounded by penguins.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I should be fine...
But please stop me if I start losing control.

rows.Line: How do I look now...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Very nice.
Your posture was already good, and you've managed to make it even better.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have you to thank, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I'm genuinely impressed by how you're able to take my advice and get it right on the first try.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you.
You saying that gives me quite a lot of encouragement.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I'm still having trouble making the right expressions and knowing where to look...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's okay. Just take it one step at a time while listening to our photographer.

rows.Line: So, Kohane, what's the plan?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... Can you try looking up a little for me this time?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Up a little? Like this...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's perfect!
As for your expression...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I thought this would be tough on Aoyagi since he's never really done anything like this before, but he's really doing his best to win the others those chocolates...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Haruka, can you take a look at this for me?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, sure.

rows.Line: Kohane, Aoyagi, thank you for keeping an eye on our things. Here, I bought us some kebabs.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, we should be the ones thanking you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Here, Haruka, you can sit next to me.

rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks.

rows.Line: Now then...

rows.Line: Let's eat.

rows.Line:
*Nom*
This is so yummy...!

rows.Line: I know, right? Airi told me about this place the other day when we were talking about grabbing a quick bite.

rows.Line: They're stuffed full with vegetables and lean meat, so it makes them healthy, filling and guilt-free.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But these are packed so tightly that it's hard to keep it all together sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I feel like it's going to burst each time I bite into it.

rows.Line: I'll need to be careful not to get any on my clothes.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. We still have our third photo left to take.

rows.Line: So, how do you guys want it to look?

rows.Line: Was that a cat?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...!
Hello there.

rows.Speaker: Cat
rows.Line: Meow, meow.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
What do you think it's saying?
Does it want something...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think it's hungry...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... But we probably shouldn't feed it, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Line: I'm sorry, but we can't give you any of our food.

rows.Line: *Frown*

rows.Line:
Oh no...

rows.Line: Meow. Meow?

rows.Line: I'm sorry, but you can't have any of this. I hope you understand...

rows.Line: Meow...

rows.Line:
I think it understands.

rows.Speaker: Cat
rows.Line: Meow.

rows.Line:
Hehe. It's showing us its belly now.
Maybe it wants a rub?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, since we can't give it any of our food...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, Aoyagi, wait...!
If you lean over like that, your kebab filling will fall.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, thank you. That was a close one...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Unless... Were you feigning giving up in an attempt to get me to drop my kebab?

rows.Speaker: Cat
rows.Line: Meow?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. If so, then it's a lot smarter than we thought.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Line: (Hang on. Where have I seen this before?)

rows.Speaker: Cat
rows.Line: Meow?

rows.Line:
Oh, it tilted its head.
Then how about I... Meeoow?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
S-S-Shizuku! Your tea!
It's gonna get all over your clothes...!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Aoyagi's a lot like Shizuku.)

rows.Line: (They both seem cool and collected at first, but they can be a little clumsy.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Also, neither seem to like giving up any commitments they've made.)

rows.Speaker: Cat
rows.Line: Meow. Meow.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Again, we're sorry.
No matter how many times you try, we can't give you any of our food.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm guessing we all feel bad about our furry friend here, so let's try to finish these as quickly as we can.

rows.Speaker: Toya & Kohane
rows.Line:
I agree.
Okay.
Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's see... I'm at school all day tomorrow, so I should make sure that I have all the right textbooks ready.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But I've finished doing all my homework, so I can just do my stretches and...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
A message...?
Oh, from An...
