rows.Line: <Hey, Haruka! You free to talk right now?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: About what...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Yeah, sure.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, that must be her...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Sorry, Haruka, I know it's late.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
<No, that's okay.
So, what did you want to talk about?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Valentine's Day.
I heard about how you helped Kohane.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Including how you taught Toya how to put on makeup and how to pose for a photo shoot.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Oh, that?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <I decided to help her a little after she told me what she was doing for you.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<A little?
You guys placed in the top ten for that contest, right?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <I don't deserve all the credit.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Aoyagi and Kohane both did an amazing job...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <When he went to put on makeup for the first time in his life, he really didn't know what to do.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <But he learned really quickly after listening very carefully to my instructions.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Not only that, he was able to do basically all the things I told him about posing in one try.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <He even started to take my advice towards the end and used it to come up with his own poses.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Yeah, Toya mentioned that!
He said he was so happy when you praised him!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Hehe. He was?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Oh, what about Kohane?
Tell me more about her!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
<Hmm... I could...
But she's probably already told you everything, right?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Yeah, but I wanna hear your side of the story. Quit holding out on me.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Okay, relax.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <So, she was definitely the most motivated out of all of us. She did everything she could to take the best pictures she could of Aoyagi.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <And her attention to detail was remarkable. She made all these fine adjustments between each shot.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Hehe. I can see it already.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <I'd seen signs of it before, but Kohane's more of a perfectionist than I realized.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<I know, right?!
Especially when it comes to photography and singing!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <She becomes good at whatever she loves doing, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I see.
Also...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
<I think that's all I have to tell you.
Satisfied?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Super duper satisfied! Thanks, Haruka!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <You're welcome.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <But the more you told me about them, the more they sounded like their usual selves.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Really...?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Yeah, like when we're having singing practice!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Toya always tries to get at the root cause of a problem and does his best to put the advice he receives into practice.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Kohane too. She always practices the same thing over and over again until she's completely satisfied.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <I didn't know that...>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Uh oh...
We've been talking for two hours!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Wow, you're right. Time really flew by...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Wanna stop here?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Probably should.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Again, thanks for what you did!
Those chocolates you guys got me were so good!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Again, you're welcome.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Anyway, night!
Let's talk again soon!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Night, An.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I wasn't expecting her to call me like this, but I guess she was just that happy.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And it ended up being pretty fun, so I'm glad I decided to help.
Rental Meeting Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hello? This is Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <It's Saito. I'm really sorry about making you all go meet that producer without me.>

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
<So, can you tell me what happened?
I'd like an update if possible...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Just a moment.
Let me put you on speakerphone...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Saito? Can you hear me?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hello?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <Yes, I can hear you!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Your timing couldn't have been better.
We were actually just about to call you after we managed to snag a meeting room.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, as for our situation...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: ...and after sharing our talk segment idea for that portion of the show, the producer gave us the okay.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Next, we'll need to find some good images and other media for our segment. We'll let the producer know once we do, and then the crew can start turning them into panels and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
<You're being asked to do that?
I thought that was the show's responsibility...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Normally, yes. Unfortunately, there isn't any time for us to check over everything they make.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, it's just easier at this point for us to find the images we want to use for panels and such.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <I see... This is more work than I was expecting for you to be given.>

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
<How are you all feeling?
You must be tired after looking at all those houses yesterday, and the shoot is tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, we're great!
After all, this is a huge opportunity for us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What she said!
We're gonna find a way to succeed no matter what!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <All of you...>

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <Please let me know if there's anything I can do!>

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <I can't be there with you right now, but I am still your manager!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we will.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We should be able to figure this out as long as we work together.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <Okay! Then, we'll talk again soon.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank goodness we got a chance to tell Saito about what happened.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! But I'm still having a hard time believing it's only been a day since we went house hunting...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me too. It feels like something that happened ages ago for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Really? It's still pretty fresh in my mind.
Remember how you broke that doorknob in that second house we saw, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Again, I didn't break it...
It was already broken, and Ms. Kawanishi agreed.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Still, my heart did skip a beat when it literally came off the door...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was just wondering what was in that room, and it ended up coming apart as I turned it...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We even looked at each other while wondering what we were going to do about it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Since “you break it, you buy it” can also apply to houses.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm not against old houses or anything, but that one might've been a bit too well-worn for my taste...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha... Imagine if the windows were cracked and there were cobwebs everywhere like a haunted house...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be fair, I guess it was just clean enough to be livable.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But the stains we saw on the floor probably meant that the roof leaks.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That would explain why the floor in the practice room felt so flimsy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But a leaky roof could be kinda fun.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You know how some things go clink and some go clonk when raindrops hit them?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I remember taking a bucket out onto the balcony during rainy days when I was little because I liked hearing those sounds so much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know what you mean. Shii and I used to sit and play beneath the eaves of our house when we were little.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We brought along empty cans and bowls to see what sorts of sounds they'd make.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I can already see you two having so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I like hearing raindrops too, but I still don't wanna deal with a leaky roof.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Also, we're getting way off topic...
We have to decide what we need for our talk segment fast!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But you're the one who brought up that doorknob, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Fine, I give. I'm sorry I had to poke fun at you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, we only have this room for a little bit, so let's get cracking.

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay.
Okay!

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Anyway, ladies, we've been chatting out here for long enough. Why don't you all come on in?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. Pardon us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This is really going to be our new home base.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I honestly still can't believe it.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Hehe. That's perfectly understandable.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: But I'm looking forward to when MORE MORE JUMP! starts calling this place home.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Us too. And we promise to take good care of it!

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: That reminds me. I have a little table that I've been meaning to give you. Also, let me pour some tea.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, how is your ankle feeling...?

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Thank you for asking.
It's feeling much better now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...
But it still hasn't fully healed yet, has it...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In that case, allow us to take care of the table and the tea.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Please, this is the least we can do since you're letting us move in upstairs.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Shizuku, Airi & Minori
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for taking the time today to explain how we should go about moving in.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You made us feel right at home.
It's really starting to feel like our new home base.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Oh, that's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Let me know if you think you need any help.
I'm very much looking forward to seeing you all move in.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you! We're also looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you!
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, if you'll excuse us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, uh... Please take care!
I hope your ankle gets all better soon!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The MORE MORE HOUSE is actually happening! I can't wait to start doing streams there.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Don't get too ahead of yourself.
We only just discussed the move-in process a minute ago.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I know.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But I understand how she feels.
I'm also very excited about this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me too. I'm looking forward to talking about how we're going to use each room.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we have some paperwork to deal with first, but we'll need to start thinking about that soon.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Actually, do any of you already have plans for them? Also, what are your thoughts on furniture?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ooh! I think one needs to be really cute, let in lots of light, have a few plants and be filled to the brim with plushies!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, plushies?
It's already starting to sound very cute.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we'll want the room where we stream to look cute.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, why don't we each bring over a few of our favorite plushies?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They should help make it feel more like a place where we live instead of a room we've designated for doing streams.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, good idea.
But I might not be able to contribute much...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You've got tons, Haruka!
I mean, your room's full of penguins.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm willing to bring over as many as we need. I don't have enough room to display all of them, so some are tucked away in my closet.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, if we do that... Won't it sort of turn into my room?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Actually, I'd like to see that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In any case, let's each jot down everything we can bring later. I mean, we don't even know how we're gonna lay things out yet.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: True.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Still, if I am going to take some over, which ones should I bring...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Hehe. I'll think about this more when I get home.)

rows.Line: Thanks for letting me take a bath first, Mom. It's all yours now.

rows.Line: Let's see... We weren't assigned any homework today, so...

rows.Line: Oh, I'm supposed to check over that magazine article. In that case, I'll clean up a little and...

rows.Line:

*Yawn...*

rows.Line: I guess my body hasn't had much time to recover. I have been pretty busy lately.

rows.Line: (But the schedule she came up with afterwards seemed doable...)

rows.Line: (On the other hand, I wanted to accept as many offers as I could to make the most of the wave we caught after Mr. Arimura's show aired.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Line: But I am glad that I went for it. Also, today was a pretty good checkpoint too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Still...

rows.Line:
I should get some sleep...
I can just wake up early tomorrow to check over that article.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For now, let's stretch...

rows.Line:
Some background music would be nice.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: I haven't forgotten about when we ran into each other on the rooftop after you'd quit being an idol!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Exhale*
That's it for my run.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll stretch after taking a quick break.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I thought I'd be more fatigued after Idol Lovers, but that's surprisingly not the case.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (If anything, this might be the best I've felt recently. Could it be because my body still remembers how I danced during the show...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Our appearance at Idol Lovers ended up going so well yesterday.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The audience went absolutely wild, and I could hear all their voices...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I wished that performance would never end...
I was having so much fun on stage that that was all I could think about.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And our incredible performance was made possible by...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Getting to perform alongside them really was huge.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They blew us all away the day at that joint rehearsal.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But when we were on stage together, they made it very clear that they also wanted to spread hope to others.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That allowed us to perform way above our usual level.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You can tell it's one of Mr. Hiiragi's groups...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And turn this moment where our hearts have become one into a really special memory!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Airi did such an amazing job yesterday.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I watched her make dramatic strides as we trained, but she absolutely soared during our performance...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I really wasn't expecting her to fly as high as she did.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That was the best performance I'd ever been a part of, and she made it happen.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (No, not just me...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Shizuku and Minori also did really well yesterday.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (One person improved so much that everyone around them became better. As a result, we were able to reach a level that we normally can't.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Which means, I...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I also need to get better.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I want to be able to do what Airi did yesterday. I want to bring out everyone's best.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I want to learn how to spread more and more hope to more and more people.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And to make that happen, for now, I need to keep practicing.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That settles that.
I think I'll keep running a bit more today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll also increase my sets for strength training—

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
A message?
Oh, it's from Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi's Message
rows.Line:
<Morning!
I'm looking at places where we can throw our Idol Lovers after-party right now. Anywhere you wanna go?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, our after-party...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Where should we go...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I really should just keep practicing like normal while sticking to my diet...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But breaks are also important.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Especially after putting on the show that we did.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Then, how about a buffet?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <One of my classmates told me about this new barbeque place that they said was really good.>

rows.Speaker: Airi's Message
rows.Line: <I'm down for all-you-can-eat barbeque!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I'll have my cheat day coincide with our after-party.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Until then, I'll need to keep doing my best...!
se_run_women_001_2
Haurka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm glad I was able to finish putting together our training schedules.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I was even able to come up with individualized plans for Tenma, Shinonome and myself, since the stages we'll each be doing are all different.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I couldn't have done this without MEIKO's help...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But we don't have much time, so these schedules are pretty intense.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I don't even know if Tenma and Shinonome will agree to do this...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Oh, that reminds me...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hey, An? Sorry, I know it's late.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<That's totally fine. Anyway, what's up?
You usually message me instead of calling like this.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I wanted to ask you something.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm going to be competing in an event called “Shinobi Battle” with Tenma and Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I heard!
Akito sounded super stoked. “If we're in it, we're in it to win it!”>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I actually just came up with some training schedules that I think will help us win.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I'd like to hear your opinion, since I feel that I may be asking too much of them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Wait, you want my advice?
I don't really know a lot about this kind of stuff...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But you're friends with both Tenma and Shinonome, right? I was hoping you could tell me more about how they train on a daily basis.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Oh, okay!
I should be able to help you there!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In that case, I'll send over what I made now. If you don't mind taking a look at it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<No, wait!
Do we have to talk about this now?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Huh? No, not necessarily...
Are you busy right now?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <No, I just thought that we could chat in person!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Are you free tomorrow after school?
If you are, wanna come over to the cafe?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm having that meeting with Minori and the others to discuss how we're going to do our Shinobi Battle stream. But I should be free afterwards...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm meeting with the other to discuss a stream, but I should be able to head over once it's done. Would that be okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Okay! Then, we'll meet at the cafe once your meeting's finished!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, sounds good.
The next day
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Welcome! Table for one?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, I'm meeting a friend.
She should be here already...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes, she arrived here a little while ago, and got some cleaning in to boot.

rows.Speaker: Haruka & An
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Here's some tea.
Sorry, this is sorta all we have, since we're closed right now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's okay. I'll gladly have this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mmm... This is nice...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd heard the cafe would be closing for a while, but it doesn't really feel like it's been closed up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. We've still been using it, just as a training space.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Speaking of which...
I took a look at the training schedules you sent over.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What did you think?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
They look really intense!
I totally get why you wanted to hear my opinion.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I had a feeling...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But they should work just fine!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Lemme start with Akito. He trains the hardest out of everyone on our team, so he's as tough as nails!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If anything, he's the type who gets excited whenever he's faced with a difficult challenge!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: As for Tenma... One of my classmates does shows with him, and she's told me a lot about him!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He's apparently been training really hard lately too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She said he can climb, or run, up walls or something now? Anyway, I don't think you have to worry about either of them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I guess I got a little ahead of myself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I mean, those two were training that day in order to make their dreams come true, after all.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry for making you gather all this information for me, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's okay.
All I really had to do was ask a friend in class.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If anything, I think it's good that you're being so careful and considerate about all this, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, this is Akito and Tenma we're talking about. You really don't need to hold back for those two.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know you're all friends, An, but I'm not sure you're allowed to say that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Heehee.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (You're always like this...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But I'm glad I asked you about this.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Thank you so much, An.)
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
98, 99, 100...!
Okay, that's one set.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm starting to get the hang of doing these exercises while wearing weights.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I guess that means my training is going well.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We have just three days left until Shinobi Battle. I need to keep this up, and get in the best shape I can.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Phew...
Three sets. That should be enough.
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sounds like you've reached a good place to stop, too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why don't we take this opportunity to rest and rehydrate, Kiritani?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you. I think I will.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Is something the matter?
You giggled after looking at us...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
We're taking a break, but you two are still wearing your weighted vests.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, we totally forgot about these...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I remember desperately gasping for air and throwing it off after completing every single set during our first day of training!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That means your hard work is paying off.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Actually, I've been wondering...
Where did you get these vests, and all that other strength-training equipment?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A yoga mat is one thing, but I doubt many people have weighted vests like these.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've become so used to a certain director using explosives and odd drones during our performances that I never thought to ask.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And now you're desensitized to these kinds of things...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, the story behind those vests involves...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hey, Airi, does the show “Battle of the Muscly Stars” ring any bells for you?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, of course it does!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The producer for the Wide World of Laughs worked on it, so I got to appear on it as Happy Everyday.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You battled against some female athletes, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Do you happen to remember the name of the company that made all the props and equipment?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The company that made the props? Yeah, I remember...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, don't tell me. You want to use them to train for Shinobi Battle.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Ideally, yes...
Do you think it'd be possible for me to borrow them?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If I recall, they don't accept personal orders, but they do rent out to individuals.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You should be able to send in a request through their website. Also, you'll be able to save on shipping by going over to their warehouse yourself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks, Airi!
I'll look into it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, the vests and other equipment we've been using were used on Battle of the Muscly Stars?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Not necessarily everything.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, a company that makes props for TV. They must have an assortment of fun things available for rental.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, they do have quite a large selection.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A giant frying pan that can make yakisoba for a hundred people, a shrine gate, a footbath...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A shrine gate and a footbath?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They even had a skating rink and a merry-go-round.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A skating rink and a merry-go-round?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What shows did they make those for, and why...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I can't say, since I only had a few minutes to see what they had in their warehouse...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, their rental fees are based on the size of each object, so you can rent out the ones that don't require construction at a very reasonable price.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see. This is a useful bit of information.
I'll have to tell Rui about this later.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? He's the last person you should be telling.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What are you going to do when he ends up building a jet-flow bathtub or a skating rink that produces lightning?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
H-Hahaha. Don't be ridiculous, Akito.
He only makes props for shows, remember?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What kind of show involves using jet-flow bathtubs and skating rinks that produce lightning?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your face is getting all twisted.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, our break's already over.
Are you two ready to continue?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, yes!
I'm ready whenever!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I've gotten pretty used to my training schedule now, so I still feel pretty fresh.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We have three days left.
Let's keep doing our best so that we can post a result we can feel proud of!

rows.Speaker: Akito & Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes!
Yeah!
One week before Haruka's birthday
Stage SEKAI - Flower Field

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Everyone! I brought Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, Haruka! You can open your eyes now!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay, here I go.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's a little bit early, but...

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you all so much!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow. You set up a birthday party in the flower field, and even prepared flower petal showers.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It was Miku and the others that suggested celebrating in the field, and doing a flower shower.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They also did most of these decorations, too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
Then, those blue balloons...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah♪
We blew up a bunch to decorate with!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And of course you need flowers on your birthday.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We actually prepared more flowers for you than just the ones we used for the flower showers.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Here, I'll go first!
Happy birthday, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you, Len.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, it's a bouquet of paper flowers.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. They're meant to be chamomile flowers.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: All the flowers are so well made!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. The first time he showed me, I thought they were real for a second.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we're just getting started.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'll go next.
Happy birthday, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow... This flower is also made out of paper? It's so big!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I spent a lot of time picking the materials, so I only made one... But this can also be used as an aroma diffuser.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow, really?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's big and eye-catching. It'd be a nice addition to any desk or table. Thank you, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haruka! Next is from me and MEIKO♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Ta-da♪
It's a flower mobile and flower garland!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow! And these are all paper flowers too?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! The flowers and petals on the mobile are cherry blossoms.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The way they sway makes it look like the petals are dancing in the air, doesn't it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's such a wonderful idea.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I can't wait to put this up in my room and see all the flowers swirl in the breeze.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, so if Rin made the mobile, does that mean you made this garland, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's right! I made it in pastel colors to suit any decor.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The flowers' colors are subdued, but there are a lot of them, so they should brighten up any room.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It would.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It might also look cute on one of my big penguin plushies...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
There are still more presents to go.
Right, Miku♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Here, Haruka! We made you a flower wreath, and a heart-shaped curio too♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow...! They're both so lavishly decorated!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I made the wreath. I got so into it while making it that I ended up making a lot more flowers than I planned♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too! I really wanted it to be a pretty heart shape, but somehow it just kept getting bigger.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I kept going “I'll put this here...oh, the silhouette is wrong now, so I'll fix this side too”♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Haha. Still, it ended up with a really nice heart shape all the same.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah... The shape turned out so beautiful. And each individual flower is so cute.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: All these presents are so wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you so much, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
You're welcome♪
You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I can't wait to put them all up in my room.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That would make us very happy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you all for helping us buy all the materials, Minori, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. You're super welcome!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I still remember when we went to buy the materials.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After our meetings ended, we pretended to be going home, and met back up at the shopping mall!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That was so exciting! It really felt like we were preparing a surprise!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You did that? When was this? I didn't notice at all.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Which means, our surprise was a success!

rows.Speaker: Airi, Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm repeating myself, but thank you so much for these presents, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll put them all in my room and take good care of them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, everyone! There's still lots of party left to enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We have low-sugar cake and plenty of snacks you can enjoy, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's all eat them together!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes!
Haruka's birthday
MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Line: Okay, I'll be over here off-camera!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. Thank you.

rows.Line:
Okay, here goes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone!
Welcome to my special birthday stream!

rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<We've been waiting!>
<Looking forward to it!>
<Haruka!>

rows.Line: First off, let's all wish Haruka a happy birthday together!

rows.Line: Ready? Go!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Happy birthday!>
<Happy B'day!>
<Have a good one!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you to all our viewers for celebrating with me, too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay! Our first segment is a party game that's sure to get exciting!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We call it “No I In Team: Birthday Edition!”

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa! What was that sound?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll be playing several games on stream, but if anyone says a word with the letter “I” in it, you'll hear the buzzer.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Our manager has the buzzer, so she'll make sure things stay fair.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh. Airi, just now...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's sneaky.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're still getting ready, so that isn't actually—

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Oh, instant buzzer! Manager's sharp!>
<Aaaand you're out!>
<This is already fun.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ahem. You see! She's really fast on the draw!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course, she'll also track how many times people mess up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, so that's why we're streaming from the office today instead of the streaming room. Because we wanted to use the whiteboard.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. We did see if we could manage in the streaming room, but it was a bit cramped...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And we haven't shown the office off yet! So, here it is! A special reveal!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<So that's why.>
<It's a cute office!>
<Feels cozy.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, now that we've gone over the buzzer, let me go over the rest of the rules!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To start, we'll all get some snacks. These are low-carb, so Haruka can enjoy them too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Each snack you have is worth one point.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: While we're playing games, every time we break the rule we'll lose a snack. Winning the games is important, but keep an eye on your snack pile too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As an extra bonus, whoever takes home the gold also gets the conf... Um, the snacks everyone lost!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh! Wow, Airi!
Nice save—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ah!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um, we haven't started yet, so that's okay, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, that one gets a pass. But be more careful once we start.

rows.Speaker: Airi
